name: simplify-mysql-mcp
description: Full toolkit for the Simplify MariaDB/MySQL database: list/describe tables, fetch/insert/update/delete rows, add columns, run SQL, and backup/restore.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List all databases on the server

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables in a chosen database

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show columns, types, and keys for a table

tools.name: fetch_rows
tools.description: Read rows from a table, with optional filters

tools.name: insert_row
tools.description: Insert a new row into a table

tools.name: add_column
tools.description: Add a new column to a table

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Run any SQL statement, including writes and DDL

tools.name: backup_database
tools.description: Back up the database to a .sql file

tools.name: restore_database
tools.description: Restore the database from a .sql backup
